remarks: GROUND-LEVEL, ZERO-STAIRS LIVING IN A PRIME LOCATION! This charming Cadiz model offers a perfectly designed 1-Bedroom, 1-Bathroom floor plan spanning 770 square feet that feels remarkable spacious due to the well-designed floor plan. Loaded with thoughtful upgrades, the home features smooth ceilings, dual-pane windows, stylish engineered wood flooring in the living  &  dining room, ceramic tile flooring in the kitchen and bathroom with carpet in the bedroom. An abundance of natural light pours into the generous living room through large pictures windows.
